name: Spiko Digital Assets Cash & Carry Fund
oneLiner: SPKCC is the USD share class of Spiko's regulated French AIF combining a digital-asset cash-and-carry basis strategy with short-duration T-bill collateral.
collateral: USD share class of the Spiko Digital Assets Cash & Carry Fund. Monthly allocation rotates between BTC and ETH cash-and-carry (basis) trades and short-duration Treasury bills/cash. Marex is the fund's sole strategy counterparty, spot digital assets are custodied at Coinbase, futures are cleared on CME, and CACEIS Bank (Credit Agricole Group) acts as depositary.
pegMechanism: USD-denominated NAV-accreting fund share; daily NAV is calculated by CACEIS Fund Administration and published on-chain through a Chainlink AggregatorV3-style oracle contract. Holdings are restricted to KYC-allowlisted addresses via Spiko's PermissionManager; minting is limited to the daily-operator role and burns to the Redemption contract's burner role.

oracleRisk.summary: SPKCC publishes its fund NAV on-chain through a Chainlink AggregatorV3-style oracle, so valuation depends on an external feed. It is a permissioned fund share rather than a borrower CDP, and no token-level collateral liquidation path is documented.

branchApplicability.rationale: Spiko describes SPKCC as a regulated fund share whose strategy rotates between BTC or ETH cash-and-carry trades and Treasury bills. Primary-market access is permissioned and fund NAV is calculated and published for the share; tokenholders do not open borrower-owned collateral positions, so there are no SPKCC collateral-market or liquidation branches to inventory.

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: SPKCC is issued through permissioned fund or issuer rails with KYC-gated primary-market access and issuer/admin controls over transfer, mint, redemption, or token administration.

mintAuthority.summary: SPKCC mints are gated by Spiko's PermissionManager on every EVM deployment: mint() requires ADMIN group 0 or daily-operator group 2, and group 0 alone can grant group 2 and replace both the token and the PermissionManager implementation. The group-0 holder is a 3-of-6 Safe on Ethereum, Arbitrum, Polygon and Base. Starknet is owned by a 3-of-5 multisig account; the Soroban deployment's owner and WASM-upgrade authority is a single ed25519 key. No deployment encodes a supply cap and no path carries a timelock.

The same shape was re-read on 2026-07-20 on Arbitrum (token 0x99f70a0e1786402a6796c6b0aa997ef340a5c6da, impl 0xa0769f7a8fc65e47de93797b4e21c073c117fc80, authority 0xa925c217e4c1c82ee721ebd496d3863d5c2d829a, block 485916291), Polygon (token 0x903d5990119bc799423e9c25c56518ba7dd19474, impl 0x15ea0ec460a0e6847ec0aa8d50a84b3a51b95f74, authority 0x344278aff344d6fb960705dc18a4912221608472, block 90573534) and Base (token 0xf695df6c0f3bb45918a7a82e83348fc59517734e, same impl and authority, block 48887968). Every EVM deployment returns getRequirements(mint) = {0,2}. The token itself carries no supply cap; issuance is gated only by group membership.

controls.label: Spiko PermissionManager (ERC1967 proxy) - shared authority policy
controls.evidence: ERC1967 impl = 0xd3f5f1524e1a472b51374a3ff41b8936eb5b658e. ADMIN() = 0 and PUBLIC() = 255. getGroupAdmins(0) = 0x01 (group 0 administers itself) and getGroupAdmins(2) = 0x01, so the ADMIN group alone can add or remove the daily-operator minter group. getRequirements(token, upgradeToAndCall 0x4f1ef286) = 0x01 and getRequirements(permissionManager, upgradeToAndCall) = 0x01: the ADMIN group alone can replace both the token and the PermissionManager implementation. On Arbitrum the deployment uses proxy 0xa925c217e4c1c82ee721ebd496d3863d5c2d829a with the same implementation bytecode; Polygon and Base reuse the 0x3442...8472 address.

controls.label: Spiko ADMIN group Safe (Ethereum and Base)

review.evidence: 2026-07-20 cross-chain enumeration closed the three questions the 2026-07-20 P2 pass left open. Arbitrum: full GroupAdded/GroupRemoved replay on PermissionManager 0xa925c217e4c1c82ee721ebd496d3863d5c2d829a resolves ADMIN group 0 to the single Safe 0x7843225ba488cf780a4fe2c842b5dc2abcf8a03e (3-of-6, v1.4.1, no guard, no modules) and getRequirements(token, upgradeToAndCall) = group {0}. Polygon: the same replay on 0x344278aff344d6fb960705dc18a4912221608472 resolves group 0 to the Safe 0xa4196f06fe948b8ca81d3dc77110d3f83d10abd9 (3-of-6); Base resolves to the Ethereum Safe 0x4eaa52b6280593a8820c45ce38f974290ae52cea. Starknet: owner() = 0x07bc8bbd7c7fcc89273726fd34bc1ffc4649ed3f2f1be43e12afe8a406a5ca9d, a multisig account with get_threshold() = 3 over 5 signers. Stellar: the Soroban instance-storage Owner is the ed25519 account GBYIQXBKEB655EB3WTRITS6RR5GXEP6SQRBLPREZHNFYKT7WBMTMPR3H, a single-key account per Horizon. The complete mint and upgrade surface is therefore enumerated on all six deployments. Reconciliation cadence and prudential supervision were not established by these chain reads and remain unknown. Reconciliation review (2026-08-08): the fund prospectus supersedes the product-page claims the 2026-07-15 pass could not qualify. The prospectus (1 Feb 2026) appoints CACEIS Fund Administration as fund accountant striking the NAV daily on a D+1 basis, with CACEIS Bank (ACPR banking licence 18129) as independent depositary safeguarding assets and monitoring cash flows, and PricewaterhouseCoopers Audit as statutory auditor - a recurring independent reconciliation with a named administrator. Supervision is prudential through the manager rather than the vehicle: Twenty First Capital SAS holds AMF portfolio-management authorisation GP-11000029, confirmed live in the AMF's own published SGP register export. The prospectus states the FPS itself is not AMF-authorised, so the prudential hook is the AIFM, depositary and distributor.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: SPKCC is issued natively by Spiko on all six chains: every deployment was re-verified on-chain 2026-07-20 as the canonical Spiko fund share (EVM authority() = Spiko PermissionManager; Starknet owner = Spiko's Starknet owner account; Stellar contract in Spiko's official stellar-contracts registry). Cross-chain transfers run over Chainlink CCIP, Spiko's documented interoperability rail, so the profile tier reflects an external validated-network transfer rail over issuer-native deployments.

reserveReview.rationale: Spiko's current producer reports the SPKCC fund as one cash-and-carry strategy envelope, not a defensible fixed 80/20 allocation. The direct exposure is classified as hedged crypto with basis, venue, custody, liquidity, counterparty, smart-contract, and concentration risks retained.
